## 데이터 저장소

![](work_in_progress.GIF){height="1in" fig-align="left"}

## 데이터 다운로드

```{r}
#| label: list_data_dt
#| echo: false
library(fs)
library(readr)
library(dplyr, warn.conflicts = FALSE)

list_path <- "files"
list_pattern <- "[.](?:xls(?:x)?|csv|rds(?:[.]gz)?)$"
desc_file <- "data_description.csv"

file_list <- dir_info(path = list_path, regexp = list_pattern,
                      type = "file", recurse = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

file_desc <- read_csv(desc_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

left_join(file_list, file_desc, by = "path") |>
  mutate(파일명 = paste0("<a href=\"", path, "\" download>",
                      path_file(path), "</a>"),
    `데이터 소스 (설명)` = description,
    수정일 = format(modification_time, "%Y-%m-%d"),
  ) |>
  select(파일명:수정일) |>
  arrange(desc(수정일)) |>
  DT::datatable(options = list(
    language = list(
      url = "https://data.custudy.org/dt_ko.json"
    )
  ), escape = FALSE, rownames = FALSE)
```
